demos.name: foundryairlines-demo
demos.title: FoundryAirlines
demos.tagline: Three Foundry agents that fill low-occupancy flights with event-aware promo banners.
demos.description: A small but realistic demo that orchestrates three Azure AI Foundry agents sequentially with the Microsoft Agent Framework: a flights agent picks the lowest-occupancy flights from a local DB, an events agent uses Bing grounding to find a real upcoming event in each destination, and a gpt-image-2 step generates a promo banner per flight. A FastAPI backend streams progress over SSE to a vanilla HTML/JS front-end.

agents.name: flights-agent
agents.role: Reads the bookings DB and returns the 5 lowest-occupancy flights as strict JSON.

agents.name: events-agent
agents.role: Finds one real upcoming event per destination city using Bing grounding.

demos.name: insurance-ai-agents
demos.title: Insurance AI Agents
demos.tagline: Governed multi-agent claims processing with an AI gateway, evals and audit trail.
demos.description: An enterprise-grade demo of the full lifecycle of governed AI agents over a critical process (auto claims). Three specialized agents (Intake, Risk, Compliance) are orchestrated with the Microsoft Agent Framework behind an Azure APIM AI gateway (content safety, token limits, managed identity), with Entra ID auth, Cosmos DB audit persistence, a whitelabel React dashboard, a real-time voice channel and an automated Eval Gate on every PR.

agents.name: claims-intake
agents.role: Structured extraction of the claim report into a typed schema.

agents.name: risk-assessment
agents.role: Risk scoring and fraud probability estimation.

agents.name: compliance
agents.role: Applies regulatory rules to produce compliance checks and a decision.

agents.name: orchestrator
agents.role: Coordinates the intake, risk and compliance agents and the audit trail.

demos.name: production-scheduling-agents
demos.title: Production Scheduling AI Agents
demos.tagline: Constraint-aware, self-healing production scheduling for manufacturing plants.
demos.description: A manufacturing plant's daily schedule collapses every time a machine goes down, a material shipment slips, or a priority order lands. This demo shows an agentic orchestration layer that sits on top of existing ERP/MES systems and behaves like an experienced production planner who never sleeps: it continuously monitors machine telemetry, material flow, and maintenance calendars; classifies disruptions against hard and soft constraints; simulates alternative schedules and their trade-offs (changeovers vs. urgency, labor balancing, energy windows); autonomously applies the best adjustment; and escalates only genuinely ambiguous decisions to a human planner. Aimed at manufacturing/operations audiences evaluating agentic AI beyond chat.

agents.name: schedule-orchestrator
agents.role: Decides autonomous adjustment vs. escalation to the planner; a deterministic policy gate enforces the rules.

agents.name: scenario-simulator
agents.role: Generates and scores alternative schedules; every proposal re-validated by the deterministic feasibility checker.

demos.name: signal-to-service
demos.title: Signal-to-Service
demos.tagline: From a telemetry anomaly to a scheduled, SOP-backed work order — with a human in the loop.
demos.description: A manufacturing predictive-maintenance demo. A simulated telemetry anomaly triggers an agent pipeline that diagnoses the failure mode and remaining useful life, retrieves and cites the correct SOP from the manuals (RAG), pauses for a human governance approval, then creates the work order, schedules a technician by skill/availability and attaches the SOP. Shows event-triggered orchestration, grounded retrieval with citations, and a human-in-the-loop approval gate.

agents.name: signal-to-service-diagnosis-agent
agents.role: Classifies the failure mode, criticality and remaining useful life from telemetry.

agents.name: signal-to-service-knowledge-agent
agents.role: Summarises and cites the correct SOP from retrieved manual passages (RAG).

agents.name: signal-to-service-action-agent
agents.role: Drafts the work order; app tools create it in the CMMS and schedule a technician.
